column7: admin_dsn host is project-admin input; pgx sized its read buffer from the server-claimed message length (default ceiling ~1 GiB), so a 5-byte header cost ~775 MB per connection and ~1.5 GB peak RSS, OOM-killing a 512 MiB cgroup within three dials (measured on dialPostgres). Fixed by internal/pgxlimits.Apply (1 MiB per message) in connectPostgres; sibling connect sites guarded by TestEveryPgxConnectInDynamicUsesTheBoundedConfig. Severity: project-admin to server-wide DoS, multi-tenant only; not traced whether a non-admin can choose the DSN. MySQL measured flat RSS, unchanged.
